description: Sample for candidate C of the codes an llm kernel puts in a reply, id = code; would live at $AOS_HOME/lib/tools/aos/kernel_llm/errors.json. Three codes only. An error has no input, so the schema key is called 'schema' here (an open point).

EndpointUnknown.description: the letter names a pack this kernel does not have

BudgetMissing.description: the budget of this window is used up; try again after resets_at

EndpointFailed.description: the endpoint function failed or timed out
